text:
sara: Quick check-in on BridgeWork onboarding — legal okayed product mention, want to align on SSO/SCIM/KMS rollout and marketplace listing timeline. Who's owning cert exchange + test users?

miguel: I can own the SSO side. Need their SAML metadata + cert thumbprint. Can we get a test IdP created? @jonah do we have a staging org for partners?

jonah: yes, staging org exists (partners-stg). I'll provision a BridgeWork tenant this afternoon. Miguel, will DM metadata once tenant is ready.

kevin: For KMS/HSM we need the connector spec — does BridgeWork support external keywrap (BYOK) or only KMS-as-a-service? If BYOK we need PKCS#11 or KMIP details.

bridgework-rep (via integrations-bot): Thanks team — we support KMIP + wrapped key import. I'll upload a KMIP test endpoint in the ticket and a sample manifest.

miguel: Perfect. For SAML: please include entityID, ACS URL, and signing cert (x509). We'll test SP-initiated first, then IdP-initiated. Quick checklist: 
- SAML metadata + cert
- test users in SCIM (create/read/update/delete)
- assertion mapping: email -> email, displayName -> name

kevin: On SCIM mapping, propose this minimal set for MVP: 
```
{
  "userName": "user.email",
  "name.givenName": "user.firstName",
  "name.familyName": "user.lastName",
  "active": "user.active"
}
```
We can expand to groups in v1.1.

jonah: Marketplace listing question — legal said we can do a joint announcement but want a 7-day embargo after final review. Marketing wants screenshots + short integration how-to by EOD Friday. Who can produce?

sara: I can pull a short how-to + 2 screenshots if QA gives the green light. Can QA run the SSO+SCIM flow tomorrow morning?

miguel: We'll run SAML tests tomorrow 9am PT in partners-stg. Kevin — can you wire the KMIP endpoint into the test tenant by then? If not, we'll mock wrapped keys.

kevin: I can have KMIP endpoint patched by 8:30am PT, but real HSM creds follow security checklist (rotate test keys). If we need faster, I'll mock the endpoint and run one integration smoke test.

integrations-bot: Ticket #BW-324 created: "BridgeWork — SSO/SCIM/KMS integration". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/BW-324 (assignee: jonah)

jonah: Assigned to me. I'll update the ticket with test steps and attach the SCIM sample CSV for creating test users.

sara: Action items: 
- jonah: provision tenant + attach SCIM CSV (by 3pm PT)
- miguel: SAML tests (tomorrow 9am PT)
- kevin: KMIP endpoint (8:30am PT or mock)
- sara: how-to + screenshots (EOD Fri if QA green)

miguel: One more security note — we need to confirm BridgeWork's key retention policy and HSM attestation doc before production. Request that in the ticket.

bridgework-rep (via integrations-bot): Noted — uploading HSM attestation and KMIP config to BW-324 now.

sara: Thanks all. If we clear tests and legal sign-off we can schedule the marketplace listing + joint blog the week after next (respecting 7-day embargo). :thumbsup:

jonah: I'll post test results in the ticket and ping this thread once done.

kevin: ping me if you hit KMIP errors — common gotcha is TLS cipher mismatch with test HSMs.

miguel: good call. I'll include a TLS checklist in BW-324.

sara: Great — closing check-in for now.
